title: factory: recommend the strong model tier for implementation workers
description:
Owner decision (2026-11-18): the balanced tier (anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5) is too weak as the implementer; on ticket 37fc5504-1588-420f-9da1-0f15ba5d6f3f it needed several reruns and a prompt after going idle for a change of a few driver lines.

Change: in .factory2/config.json set models/assignment_types/implementation from "balanced" to "strong". Nothing else in the model policy changes: the other assignment types (including test_design: balanced), difficulty_floor, retry_escalation and the provider tier tables stay as they are.

Done when: flow start / flow brief --role implement of a ticket with difficulty low, medium, high and unknown recommends the strong tier for every provider with a model policy (anthropic claude-opus-5-5, reasoning high), verified with the recommendation output of the Factory CLI (for example policy select, or the recommendation field of flow brief on an open ticket), and the configured flow checks pass. If AGENTS.md or another instruction file states the implementation tier explicitly, update it in the same change; they are expected to only point to the rule files. No application code, test or Xcode project change.
